still_usable_note: Google revised its earlier universal shutdown plan: only links that showed no activity in late 2024 and received the deactivation interstitial were targeted for deactivation after August 25, 2025; other goo.gl links continue to function.
summary: Google no longer treats all goo.gl links as universally shutting down. A defined inactive subset was targeted for deactivation, while other existing goo.gl links remain supported.
current_state: Link behavior is scope-dependent: targeted inactive links no longer work after the 2025 boundary, while other goo.gl links continue functioning.
known_unknowns: Whether a particular goo.gl URL is disabled depends on the link-specific activity/deactivation condition described by Google.
notes: Corrects the older display assumption that all goo.gl links would stop working.
